results.correct_value: About 10 mi round trip (roughly 4.8-5 mi each way)
results.evidence: The SummitPost Mount Stone page gives 9-10 miles round trip for the Putvin route; a 2011 day-hike report gives about 10 miles round trip with 5,000 ft; the FKT route page gives 9 mi; a SummitPost comment relays a 4.8 mi one-way figure, matching the row's approach and summit waypoint. The 8.5 mi itinerary figure and the 11 mi overview figure are outliers. dist_km (8.9 km) was left alone: it is a one-way-shaped figure and not clearly a different quantity.

results.correct_value: About 10 hours car-to-car (roughly 5.5 h up, 4 h down)
results.evidence: The SummitPost Mount Stone page gives 10 hours as the average total time (6 very fast, 14 leisurely). An independent 2010 trip report logs about 4.3 h to the lake, 1.9 h to the summit and a return that totals roughly 10 hours. descent_text already says ~5.5 h up and 4 h down, ~10 h. The 9 h fields and the 12-13 h schedule are brought to 10 h: summit 11:00 AM, down by 3:30 PM, which also sits inside the 1:00 PM turnaround.

SummitPost describes heading north from Lake of the Angels into a talus/boulder basin below St. Peter's Gate, i.e. slopes rising north from the lake, which would face south; but no source states the aspect of the snow-holding ground, and snow can linger in north-facing pockets within it. Would be settled by a topo reading of the specific snow slope the text means.

Searched Mountain Project, SummitPost, CascadeClimbers and NWHikers trip reports (the latter two would not load) and the Lemke Pickets traverse page; none states a car-to-car gain for the North Buttress. gain_ft 6,000 still matches only the approach. Would be settled by a trip report stating the whole-trip gain.

The Mountain Project route page for the East Ridge/SE Face lists it as a 4-pitch, 400 ft Grade II. The SummitPost East Ridge route page (different author) lists Grade II, 5.6 YDS. commitment and alpine_grade already say II; the grade column and the pitch-1 note saying III-IV are corrected.

patches.find: the standard published rating for the climb is III-IV, 5.6.
patches.replace: the standard published rating for the climb is II, 5.6.

results.evidence: A 2018 trip report gives 19 miles round trip and a 600-8,151 ft range but no car-to-car gain; no route page (Mountain Project, SummitPost) states total gain or loss. Would be settled by a trip report stating the whole-trip gain and descent.

The SummitPost East Ridge page describes the approach from the Chopping Block saddle as scree, talus, a short snowfield and a couloir with no glacier; a 2018 trip report via Terror Basin reports no glacier travel; but the Terror Glacier lies on Degenhardt's south slope right beside the Terror-Degenhardt saddle this route starts from, and no source says whether it is crossed or whether a bergschrund exists. Would be settled by a report of the saddle approach naming the glacier either way.

The Mountain Project Stoddard Buttress page gives a 2,500 ft Grade IV climb but no car-to-car gain; CascadeClimbers trip reports would not load and no other page states a total. Would be settled by a trip report stating the whole-trip gain.
